x: The sarangi is an indigenous Indian bowed instrument; the sitar and sarod owe their origin to Persian influence and the tabla is credited to the Indo-Islamic tradition. So the sarangi is not of Indo-Islamic origin.
source: PMF IAS Indian Art & Culture p.(music) – 'the sitar and the sarod (both of which owe their origin to Persian influences)'; sarangi 'a bowed string instrument representing India'
evidence: PMF IAS Indian Art & Culture (Hindustani instruments: sarangi bowed instrument representing India)
Ghatna Chakra note: MPPSC key (d) Shehnai is wrong
dispute: The MPPSC 2013 official key and many books give the Shehnai. PMF credits Amir Khusrau with the Sarangi; authorities are split.
